title: TradingGYM: the agent operator workspace
question: Choose the composition to carry into the working app. Mockups use synthetic sample data; the final interface uses the existing APIs and keeps live execution disarmed.

options.label: A · Mission sequence
options.thesis: Observe, research, and execution status stay visible above the market workspace.
options.viewport: A persistent navigation rail, clear agent capability strip, and one broad market table.
options.risk: Uses more vertical space before the market rows.

options.label: B · Market register
options.thesis: The market table leads, with agent status kept in the sidebar.
options.viewport: A navigation rail, summary band and FX context, followed by a spacious market watch.
options.risk: The autonomous-agent goal is less prominent.

options.label: C · Research bench
options.thesis: Markets and paper-research context share the same working viewport.
options.viewport: Top navigation, a status ribbon, and side-by-side market and research panes.
options.risk: Narrower market comparisons and more content competing for attention.
